_meta.title: Abstract places of the town and the plain for the Phase 5 population simulation (Xerxes yr 19, court absent by default)
_meta.frame: grid metres (east, north), as src/data/settlement.json and people_places.json
_meta.status: ABSTRACT, NOT RENDERED. The settlement geometry is Phase 6 and does not exist; these are named places with a representative position used only for walking times and for 'where is this person' queries. Nobody stands at these coordinates in the rendered world. Tier C throughout unless a row says otherwise.
_meta.tiers: A attested / B inferred (search extracts capped at B) / C reconstructed. Zones come from settlement.json (existence B, extent C); every facility position is C because SETTLEMENT.md section 7 found no storehouse, stable or burial ground located.

the town's burial ground (D-209): the dead are carried out, coated in wax and buried in the earth (Herodotus 1.140, read, a Greek claim: B). No burial ground in use in 467 is located (SETTLEMENT section 6); placed C on dry untilled ground at the foot of Kuh-e Rahmat 1.1 km S of the Terrace, 250 m E of the lower town; low earth mounds. site_people.note: research/PLAIN.md §4: the unlocated secure sites hold 150-3,000 people each (total <= 44,000). The rank-size rule is kept, with no site above 3,000: the excess of the largest ranks goes to the others in proportion to their rank weights (was: v_35 8,491 people, more than the town, and v_14 4,247; shadow review r4 S9, r5 B S8; D-175)

villages.note: Sumner: 39 secure + 18 possible Achaemenid sites, 675 ha, <= 44,000 people in a five-level hierarchy (B). Only the 39 secure sites are populated (4 located + 35 unlocated with an abstract distance from the Terrace); sizes follow a rank-size rule scaled to the plain working total in population.json (C)
